mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.vw_PublicStory WHERE StoryId = #{storyId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

MERGE dbo.ReadingHistory WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t USING (SELECT #{userId} AS UserId, #{storyId} AS StoryId, #{chapterId} AS ChapterId) AS src ON t.UserId = src.UserId AND t.StoryId = src.StoryId WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ScrollPercent = CASE WHEN t.LastChapterId = src.ChapterId THEN t.ScrollPercent ELSE 0 END, LastChapterId = src.ChapterId, UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (UserId, StoryId, LastChapterId) VALUES (src.UserId, src.StoryId, src.ChapterId) OUTPUT inserted.ScrollPercent;
mapper.update: MERGE dbo.ReadingHistory WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t USING (SELECT #{userId} AS UserId, #{storyId} AS StoryId, #{chapterId} AS ChapterId, CAST(#{scrollPercent} AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS Scroll) AS src ON t.UserId = src.UserId AND t.StoryId = src.StoryId WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET LastChapterId = src.ChapterId, ScrollPercent = src.Scroll, UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (UserId, StoryId, LastChapterId, ScrollPercent) VALUES (src.UserId, src.StoryId, src.ChapterId, src.Scroll);
mapper.select: SELECT h.StoryId, h.LastChapterId AS ChapterId, c.ChapterNo, c.Title AS ChapterTitle, h.ScrollPercent, h.UpdatedAt FROM dbo.ReadingHistory h JOIN dbo.Chapter c ON c.ChapterId = h.LastChapterId AND c.Status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.IsDeleted = 0 WHERE h.UserId = #{userId} AND h.StoryId = #{storyId}
